Delhi Schools to Close for BRICS Summit

Schools in Delhi will be closed on September 11, 2026, due to the upcoming BRICS summit. The Education Directorate ordered the closure of both government and private schools. The 18th BRICS summit is scheduled to take place in New Delhi at Bharat Mandapam from September 12-13, 2026. The summit is expected to involve 11 countries and analyze its potential impact on global trade.
